user.title: Mailbox for letter announcements
user.description: The mailbox that receives Deutsche Post mails ("Ein Brief ist unterwegs zu Ihnen"). For GMX enable "POP3/IMAP access" in the settings; with two-factor login use an app password. For several mailboxes simply add the integration again. "Visible to" limits widget/API access to the chosen users.

data.name: Account name (e.g. Christian, Johanna)
data.tage: Keep letters for this many days
data.ha_benutzer: Visible to (Home Assistant users; none selected = all)
data.paket_absender: Sender of parcel announcements (DHL; empty = no parcels)
data.ereignis_absender: Include the sender in the event "briefankuendigung_neu" (stored in the Home Assistant database)

error.anmeldung: Login rejected – check address/password and enable "POP3/IMAP access" at GMX.
error.verbindung: IMAP server not reachable – check server and port.
error.unbekannt: Unexpected error while checking the mailbox.
